subtasks.title: Closed-month settle window on the TTL ladder
subtasks.approach: Extend DashboardWidget::getCacheTTL with an optional month-end. Impersonation still returns now()->addSeconds(10) before any other branch. Index 0 still returns now()->addMinutes(10). Index !== 0 with a null month-end still returns now()->addYear(), so a caller that does not name a month keeps today's behavior. Index !== 0 with a month-end younger than 8 days returns now()->addMinutes(10). That 10-minute span includes the ~2 hour minimum (one hourly refresh past month end) and the arrival-reprocess window. At 8 days or older, return now()->addYear(). Add CLOSED_MONTH_SETTLE_FULL_SECONDS = 8 * 86400 next to the method. Do not add a second intermediate duration. Thread the month end into every year-cache writer that already knows the month: DashboardWidget::getMonthlyData (the $i loop), the last_month arm near line 391, UniqueScanCounts past-month puts (per month, not one TTL for the whole batch), RatioAgainstUniqueScans's write loop, RecoveryCounts's month puts, and SharedHitStatsData's past-month puts. UniqueScanCounts::pastMonthCacheTTL's 10-minute impersonation floor stays and still applies only when the ladder returns something shorter. Do not change getCacheTTL's impersonation result to satisfy that floor.
subtasks.intended_diffs: getCacheTTL gains ?DateTimeInterface $monthEndedAt = null. New unit test, no ClickHouse: impersonation is 10 seconds even when the month ended yesterday; a month that ended 1 hour ago and a month that ended 3 days ago are 10 minutes; a month that ended 9 days ago is 1 year; a null month-end at index 1 is still 1 year. Update the four writer loops to pass that month's endOfMonth(). Leave UniqueLprCaseClaims::getCacheTTL's 60-second floor and its [3600, 86400] series pair untouched.

subtasks.title: One Y-m key for the ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery open month
subtasks.approach: UniqueScanCounts::getMonthlyData and UniqueScansLeaderboard::chartSeries use the literal 'this_month' for i === 0. RatioAgainstUniqueScans::fetchUniqueScansSeries uses Y-m for that same bucket, so the three ratio cards miss the value UniqueScanCounts just wrote and issue another scans_cold read. Store and read the open month as Y-m (the calendar month in the viewer's safe timezone) on sharedMonthCacheKey. Do not bump -v1: the payload stays a bare int. Do not change the dashboard date filter value 'this_month', and do not change sharedRangeCacheKey or the this_month/last_month range-window contract between UniqueScanCounts and UniqueScansLeaderboard. resolveCurrentMonthFromCold writes the int under the Y-m key with getCacheTTL(0). Past-month writes already use Y-m; t1 makes their TTL per month. Leaderboard chartSeries stays a passive reader. CompanyMetricsOverview::cards() order stays unique-scan-counts before unique-scans-leaderboard.
subtasks.intended_diffs: Delete the i === 0 ? 'this_month' : Y-m split in the two month-series readers and in UniqueScansLeaderboardTest::seedAllSharedMonthsZero. subtasks.title: Keep LprRepossessionsQuery shared keys and put them on the ladder
subtasks.approach: Do not rename, hash, or drop sharedMonthlySeriesCacheKey or sharedWindowCacheKey. Do not change their payload contracts (series array versus int db_repos). Replace both heldFlexible([3600, 86400]) call sites in LprRepossessions with a pair derived from the ladder. The series map includes the open month, so its TTL is getCacheTTL(0), not the year arm. The today/last_7d window key is also getCacheTTL(0). Convert the DateTimeInterface to [seconds, seconds] so flexible's hard TTL does not outlive the ladder. Stay on heldFlexible so the companion key and the cold lock stay shared. Do not add a new minimum that cancels the 10-second impersonation collapse; the class docblock records that the 33.7s tail can outlast that TTL, and the cold lock still single-flights a total miss. The series key stays without :tz=.
